releaseNotes.1.0.0: Initial SDK release: extension manifests, capability grants, IPC protocol v1, source control, build, and terminal sandbox routes.
releaseNotes.1.1.0: Twelve new capability IDs: database explorer, CI/visual workflows, sandbox view, virtualization view, deploy console, simulator view, live preview, UI builder, symbols browser, docs search, dictionary, and device connect.
releaseNotes.1.2.0: Security family: use.Security umbrella capability with security.addValue, security.hasValue, security.listValueIDs, security.deleteValue, and security.useValue routes; deployConsole.view and virtualization.view; USER_CANCELLED error code; security audit events.
